scenes.title: Title Card & SIH Problem Statement
scenes.text: This is VitalSense, an offline-first Android application that connects rural patients, ASHA workers, doctors, and health administrators in one ecosystem.

scenes.title: The Problem Context
scenes.text: In many rural areas, weak connectivity and low digital literacy make timely healthcare hard to reach. VitalSense is built to work exactly where the internet doesn't.

scenes.title: The 4-in-1 Solution Architecture
scenes.text: One app, four roles. Patients, ASHA workers, doctors, and health administrators each get their own permission-aware workflow, inside a single native Android codebase.

scenes.title: Role Selection & Multilingual Accessibility
scenes.text: At launch, users select their role with a single tap. The interface instantly adapts to English, Hindi, Tamil, or Marathi, making navigation natural for vernacular communities.

scenes.title: Patient Experience & IoT Vitals
scenes.text: For patients like Ramesh, the dashboard presents a simple, icon-driven interface. Vitals like pulse rate and blood oxygen can be captured seamlessly from connected health sensors and saved directly to the offline health record.

scenes.title: ASHA Proxy Care & Care Journey
scenes.text: Frontline ASHA workers act as digital proxies for non-literate citizens—conducting home visits, updating ABHA digital health cards, and tracking a unified longitudinal care journey across clinic visits and lab investigations.

scenes.title: AI Prescription OCR & Jan Aushadhi Locator
scenes.text: A photo of a paper prescription is processed on-device with ML Kit OCR, auto-cropped, and digitized into structured dosages. Patients can then locate prescribed medicines at nearby Jan Aushadhi stores with real-time stock indicators.

scenes.title: Doctor Workflow & Specialist Referrals
scenes.text: Doctors receive an organized OPD queue sorted by clinical severity. From their consultation desk, doctors review longitudinal history, issue digital prescriptions, manage IPD bed admissions, and directly refer high-risk cases to tertiary specialists.

scenes.title: District Admin & Disease Surveillance
scenes.text: District health officers monitor real-time disease outbreak heat maps and longitudinal symptom curves. When an outbreak like malaria is detected, administrators broadcast instant health directives to frontline workers across affected villages.

scenes.title: Emergency SOS & Cellular SMS Fallback
scenes.text: In a critical emergency, one tap triggers the SOS system. It transmits GPS coordinates to nearby doctors and ASHA workers, and automatically falls back to cellular SMS when mobile data is unavailable.

scenes.title: Mental Wellness & Guided Box Breathing
scenes.text: To address mental health in rural areas without stigma, VitalSense offers simple, icon-based emotional check-ins and guided box breathing exercises that guide users with visual cues.

scenes.title: Offline-First Engine Architecture
scenes.text: Under the hood, an atomic Room database outbox and WorkManager background synchronization keep every action functional in zero-connectivity dead-zones, syncing seamlessly once network connectivity resumes.

scenes.title: Outro & Scan to Download Prototype
scenes.text: VitalSense: healthcare that keeps working, even when the network doesn't. Scan the QR code to test the live prototype on GitHub.
